priorityList.notes: Pop Combustion once Improved Scorch's debuff is fully stacked on the current target, for a guaranteed run of Fire crits. Fix round 4: tracks the engine's own debuff id (12873, sim/core/debuffs.go's ImprovedScorchAura), which the mage's own Scorch casts stack when Improved Scorch is talented (sim/mage/talents.go's applyImprovedScorch, sim/mage/scorch.go's ApplyEffects) -- restored after fix round 3 mistakenly treated this as impossible. 12873 is not in spellconst (it is an engine-side aura id, not a client spell), a known, deliberate exception for this one condition.

Scorch to apply or refresh the five stacks of Improved Scorch's debuff before it falls off. Fix round 4: restored (see top-level notes) -- this only ever stacks with the Improved Scorch talent taken, so it is functionally inert under this build's no-talent smoke run the same way Combustion above is, not a permanently uncastable line.
Fire Blast on cooldown as a free extra nuke that does not compete for Scorch or Fireball casts.
Fireball is the primary filler once Improved Scorch's debuff is up.
